title: R$^2$ Flow: Recursive Self-Improvement via Recursive Skill Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2609.33867v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLM-based agents can improve themselves across tasks by reusing and revising the skills they orchestrate into executable procedures. Flow-based training fits this loop: it samples procedures in proportion to reward, and the flow through each skill credits it for the next library revision. Three obstacles stand in the way of making this self-improvement reliable: flow training suffers strategy collapse over tree-structured histories; nonnegative flow-based credit rewards frequent use as if it were benefit; and library edits rest on the task reward the policy optimizes. We introduce R$^2$ Flow, a recursive self-improvement framework that alternates policy learning, independent verification, and versioned skill-library updates on a shared-state orchestration graph. translated_title: R$^2$ Flow：通过递归技能演化实现递归自我改进
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体能够通过复用和修订其编排为可执行程序的技能，在跨任务中实现自我改进。基于流（flow）的训练恰好契合这一循环：它按奖励比例对程序进行采样，而流经每个技能的流则为其在下次技能库修订中提供功劳归因。要使这种自我改进变得可靠，需要克服三个障碍：流训练在树状结构的历史上会遭遇策略坍缩；非负的基于流的信用分配会把频繁使用误当作有益而加以奖励；技能库的修订又依赖于策略所优化的任务奖励。我们提出 R$^2$ Flow——一个递归自我改进框架，它在共享状态的编排图上交替执行策略学习、独立验证和版本化的技能库更新。该图会合并仅在独立步骤顺序上不同的历史记录，使流训练能够在等效执行之间汇集证据。通过流份额读出……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出 R$^2$ Flow 递归自我改进框架，在共享状态编排图上交替进行策略学习、独立验证与版本化技能库更新，并通过合并等效执行历史和流份额读出机制，解决流训练中的策略坍缩、信用分配偏差与奖励依赖三大难题，实现智能体可靠的递归自我改进。
en_tdlr: R$^2$ Flow is a recursive self-improvement framework that alternates policy learning, independent verification, and versioned skill-library updates on a shared-state orchestration graph, leveraging merged equivalent-execution histories and flow-share readouts to overcome strategy collapse, biased credit assignment, and reward dependency in flow-based training.
